title: Fixed coordinates of a combined assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$ and $y$ assign a sign to each coordinate outside $P$. The assignment formed by combining $z$ and $y$ agrees with $z$ at every coordinate in $P$.
